_about: Copy to live.json at your repo root. agent_cmd is the SAME command production uses; {task} is replaced with the task text.
task: Run the resume routine, then work on the next item in progress/feature_list.json. Stop after one item.
_isolation: netns: Linux, the agent has no network except the logging proxy (tested). docker: same idea in a container with --network none (experimental; needs the kit image). none: relies on the agent honouring proxy settings; on macOS prefer Claude Code's own sandbox setting.
_track: Optional. Set "track" to a full kit track id (claude-code, claude-agent-sdk, microsoft-agent-framework, google-adk, langgraph, openai-agents-sdk, crewai, strands-agents) to start from that track's agent_cmd; set KIT_PYTHON to the track's venv python. Keys you set here still win.
